_about: ESPN lineup slot id -> position. Decodes settings.rosterSettings.lineupSlotCounts from the ESPN read API.
_verification: The offensive, D/ST, K, Bench, IR and FLEX ids were confirmed against ESPN's own built-in 2026 'FFL PPR Scoring' preset (leaguedefaults/3), whose lineupSlotCounts decode exactly to ESPN's documented standard PPR lineup: 1 QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, 1 TE, 1 FLEX, 1 D/ST, 1 K, 7 Bench, 1 IR. The IDP ids (8-15) are the commonly-cited mapping and were not exercised here; this league uses none of them.

_uklTargetLineupSlotCounts._comment: What the Ultimate Keeper League's ESPN lineupSlotCounts SHOULD look like, per the Smart Draft room and the 2026 DRAFT.xlsx Roster sheet. Bench is 7 not 5 — see data/espn-reconciliation.md. Compare this against whatever the real pull returns.
